description: Croatian company statutory entries from the official Sudski registar (daily snapshot): every typed entry in register order (108 types: founding act, statute, legal form, capital changes, mergers and divisions, enterprise contracts, dissolution grounds, court decisions). The published text is served only for a closed list of entry types without natural persons (`texte_retenu: true` otherwise); court decisions come as court, reference and date. A sole trader (trgovac pojedinac, t.p.) or an undecided legal form returns 404, not billed; so does a name covered by an objection. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

oib.description: 11-digit Croatian OIB (e.g. 92803032010); an 8- or 9-digit MBS court-register number is accepted too

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
